items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know those records they made there with Lionel Hampton and Lawrence Brown... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes, 'Ding Dong Daddy 'Confessing'.

ctx.x: the best job. And that's when I met Louis, was in '32. The first time I ever seen Louis and he was working at the Cotton Club. It was the big club. They made more money. And Fats Waller had played the Cotton Club with Les Hite. Les Hite was the home band.
And they would come in as sort of guest stars?

Yes. Now Les had Marshall Royal in his band. He had Lawrence Brown in his band. He had Lionel Hampton in his band. He had the big names. Where I think we had, we had the best band. Because we had a battle with them one time and I know we won, everybody said we won.
